learningObjectives: Identify the main tools and panels used in Figma.
Create and organize basic frames, layers, and objects.
Apply fundamental layout and alignment tools in a design file.

activities.title: Figma Workspace Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the main areas of the Figma workspace.

content.concept: Figma organizes design work through tools, canvas, layers, properties, assets, and reusable resources.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Tool Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each design task with the correct tool.

content.concept: Figma tools support tasks such as selecting, drawing, creating frames, adding text, and arranging objects.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Frame Builder
activities.instruction: Build a basic mobile interface frame.

content.concept: Frames define the boundaries of screens and containers and provide the foundation for structured interface layouts.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Layer Organization Lab
activities.instruction: Arrange layers into a clear structure.

content.concept: Well-organized layers make complex designs easier to understand, edit, and maintain.
